title: JointGV: Structure-Aware Correction of Visual World Models with Parallel Graph Dynamics for Long-Horizon Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.22543v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual world models predict future visual states conditioned on actions, but recursive errors in entity poses and spatial relations limit their long-horizon prediction for robot planning and control. We ask whether a separately predicted relational state can correct this drift without restructuring the visual model. This is challenging because graph nodes and visual states share neither elements nor a feature space. We propose Joint Graph--Visual Dynamics Correction (JointGV), a plug-in based on a cross-granularity dynamics hypothesis: despite their different representations, graph-node and visual-state changes describe the same physical transition. JointGV rolls out a task-conditioned scene graph alongside the visual world model, couples their predicted changes, and combines the resulting graph-motion context with graph-predicted node positions to compute a bounded residual. translated_title: JointGV：利用并行图动力学实现结构感知的视觉世界模型校正，以支持长时程建模
translated_abstract: 视觉世界模型在动作条件下预测未来的视觉状态，但实体位姿和空间关系中的递归误差限制了其面向机器人规划与控制的长时程预测能力。我们探究是否能够在不重构视觉模型的前提下，利用单独预测的关系状态来校正这种漂移。这项任务具有挑战性，因为图节点与视觉状态既不共享元素，也不共享特征空间。我们提出了联合图-视觉动力学校正方法JointGV，这是一个基于跨粒度动力学假设的插件：尽管表示形式不同，图节点变化与视觉状态变化描述的是同一种物理转变。JointGV在视觉世界模型运行的同时并行推演一个以任务为条件的场景图，将两者的预测变化相互耦合，并将由此获得的图运动上下文与图预测的节点位置相结合，以计算出有界残差。图学习与校正的梯度不会传播到（视觉模型内部）……
tldr: JointGV提出了一种即插即用的图-视觉联合动力学校正方法，通过并行推演任务条件下的场景图、耦合其与视觉世界模型的预测变化并施加有界残差校正，在不重构视觉模型的前提下抑制实体位姿与空间关系的递归误差，从而显著提升长时程预测能力。
en_tdlr: JointGV is a plug-in that corrects recursive drift in visual world models by rolling out a parallel task-conditioned scene graph, coupling its dynamics with the visual model's predictions, and applying a bounded residual correction to improve long-horizon prediction without restructuring the visual model.
